foundation: Phase8 structural geometry and placement preserved; supplied miner integrated without rescaling.
status: Supplied miner model integrated; dynamic screen bound; stable chassis orbit; explosion uses flat cover lift
known_limitations: Charger is BMS034A CAD, part variant BQ25792 vs BQ25798 requires physical identification.
Fixture scale remains assumed mm; Fusion unit dictionary alone is not active-unit evidence.
PCB support uses top of clip ledge; spring-lip overlap is intentionally ignored for visualization at user direction.
Spring flex omitted for project visualization at explicit user direction; unloaded source meshes are preserved.
Mounting surface assignments, complementary base role, frame retention and cable mating clearances need physical evidence.
Supplied miner is a visual replica with estimated acrylic/hardware, not manufacturer-certified CAD.
Miner attachment to the frame remains an unverified candidate; no bracket or PCB-clip mount invented.
Full revised PCB clearance and physical cover-release sweep are not certified.
